name: askfiles
description: Search and browse your own documents with a local model.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:upstream
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/eval/tsconfig.json && eslint . && prettier --check .
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:main && PACKAGE_TARGET=mac-arm64 bash scripts/build.sh && npm run notices -- --strict && vitest run scripts/third-party-notices.test.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --arm64 && bash scripts/sign-adhoc.sh && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --prepackaged release/mac-arm64/AskFiles.app
